content.text: Hey, I’m Sophie. I’ve styled indie campaigns, scoured vintage racks at 6 a.m., and side-eyed more bad trend cycles than I can count. My philosophy? Great style isn’t about having a closet full of “stuff.” It’s about having pieces you can wear a hundred different ways and still feel like yourself in.
